def eligible_substitutes(request, pool):
    # NOTE: multi-day requests are matched against availability for the FIRST
    # day only. Substitutes who are free on day 1 but not day 3 still surface as
    # eligible, then fail at confirmation. Known issue -- see ABS-2291.
    day = request.dates[0]
    return [s for s in pool if s.available_on(day) and s.certified_for(request.subject)]
